0.name: NO_AI
0.purpose: Deterministic code for hashing, validation, state transitions, aggregation and routine reports.

1.name: LOW_COST_INTELLIGENCE
1.purpose: Categorization, extraction, summarization and simple documentation.

2.name: STRONG_REASONING
2.purpose: Architecture, difficult debugging, cross-project synthesis, experiment design and opportunity reasoning.

3.name: INDEPENDENT_ADVERSARIAL_REASONING
3.purpose: Red-team evaluation, consequential architecture/self-improvement verification and high-impact promotion review.

invariants: Tier 0 is selected whenever deterministic_sufficient=true unless independent adversarial verification is explicitly required.
No model route can grant authority, approve an action, or upgrade evidence state.
A non-Tier-0 route requires an explicitly enabled provider and model compatible with the request data classification.
Every non-Tier-0 route must have a finite precomputed maximum cost not exceeding the request cost ceiling.
Tier 3 requires a nonempty builder independence group and a verifier model with a different independence group.
Provider/model prestige does not affect routing value; only verified downstream outcome feedback may later adapt routing.
Prompt/payload content is not stored in routing ledgers; only sanitized IDs, hashes, usage and cost metadata are retained.
Human-gated ACT, customer communication, payments and live trading remain governed outside the model router.
